instruction.text: The trapezium on the graph is to be moved down by 3 squares. Drag the trapezium at the bottom to the position where the trapezium would be after the translation.
The triangle on the graph is to be moved 2 squares to the left. Drag the triangle at the bottom to the position where the triangle would be after the translation.
The pentagon on the graph is to be moved 1 square to the right and up by 4 squares. Drag the pentagon at the bottom to the position where the pentagon would be after the translation.
The triangle on the graph is to be moved 3 squares to the right. Give the coordinates of the highlighted corner that it would have after the translation.
The rhombus on the graph is to be moved up by 4 squares. Give the coordinates of the highlighted corner that it would have after the translation.
The triangle on the graph is to be moved 4 squares to the right and up by 2 squares. Give the coordinates of the highlighted corner that it would have after the translation.
